about: The collecta of the formulary “Sunday after Ascension” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty and everlasting God, make us ever bear a devoted will toward Thee and serve Thy majesty with a sincere heart. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
